advice: Weight loss of even 5–10% helps periods and acne. Hormonal treatment takes 3 months to show benefit. Get USG pelvis and hormone tests as advised.

name: Acne with PCOS / hormonal acne

rx.drug: Tab. Ethinylestradiol 0.035 mg + Cyproterone acetate 2 mg
rx.instr: 21 days on, 7 days off; start day 1 of period. Rule out contraindications (smoking >35 y, migraine with aura, thrombosis)
Add if inadequate response; check potassium in renal disease
